subject: Re: Deployment mode & security requirements (HIPAA / SOC2 / BAA) - follow up
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-10T15:02:00Z
Subject: Deployment options & next steps — HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up

Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

1) Primary constraint: Elara needs a HIPAA-compliant deployment for PHI processing (clinical notes ingestion + triage).
2) Two deployment paths that fit your needs: 
   - Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity): predictable throughput, data isolation within our infra, SLA options. 
   - Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem): customer-managed network, full data plane control, required for some of your auditor recommendations.
   - Hosted API (our standard public endpoints) is possible with a signed BAA only for lower-risk use-cases — but given you handle identifiable PHI at scale, Dedicated or Private are the safer choices.

Action items I committed to on the call: 
- Attach Redwood SOC2 Type II summary and a draft BAA for legal review (attached).
- Confirm list of evidence your auditors want (audit logs retention window, encryption at rest/kms, identity providers, penetration test cadence).
- Provide high-level timeline and purchase options for Dedicated vs Private (cost delta / procurement steps).

Can you confirm which evidence items are must-have for Elara’s audit? If you prefer, Tom we can do a short follow-up with your security owner to align on required artifacts.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary_2026.pdf, Redwood_Draft_BAA_2027.docx

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@elarahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-10T17:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment options & next steps — HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up

Thanks Dylan — helpful recap. 

Must-haves from our side (what our auditors flagged):
- SOC2 Type II report (summary is fine for pre-purchase; full report + management response will be required before go-live).
- Signed BAA.
- Evidence of encryption at rest & key management (KMS/HSM details).
- Audit log retention >= 365 days and ability to export logs for third-party review.
- Network isolation details and support for Private VPC peering (our infra team prefers VPC).

Given the last two items, our security and procurement teams lean toward Private VPC or on-prem. Can you confirm if Redwood’s Private option supports HSM integration and whether on-prem deployment is actually available as a packaged offering or only custom engagements?

We’d like to get an initial statement of work and high-level pricing so we can start procurement conversations — timeline: ideally procurement kickoff end of March.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of IT Security | Elara Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-11T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment options & next steps — HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up

Sarah — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

- SOC2: Attached summary is the Type II report executive summary. We can provide the full redacted SOC2 Type II report and our management response under NDA; that is standard for customers going to production.
- BAA: Draft attached — editable doc that our legal team can iterate on.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS in VPC deployments (bring-your-own KMS via AWS KMS or customer HSM appliances for on-prem). Dedicated also supports KMS but for HSM-level key isolation we recommend Private/on-prem.
- Audit logs: We support >= 365d retention as an add-on; logs can be exported via S3 or delivered to your SIEM.
- Private VPC: we support AWS VPC peering and secure transit; on-prem is offered as a packaged deployment but requires a short professional services engagement (2–4 weeks) for install and validation.

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll loop in Solutions (Marissa) to produce a 1-page deployment options matrix (cost / timeline / evidence mapping).
- Legal: we’ll route the draft BAA to our legal team and get comments within 3 business days.
- If Elara wants to move toward procurement kickoff end of March, we should lock a pilot scope and preferred deployment (Private VPC vs on-prem).

Marissa / Neha — can you put together the deployment options matrix and an initial SOW template we can share with Elara?

Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-11T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment options & next steps — HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up

Adding notes for the deliverables: 

- Deliverable 1: Deployment options matrix (1 page) — Dedicated vs Private VPC vs On-prem 
   - Cost bands (pilot / monthly committed)
   - Timeline to pilot (Dedicated: ~2 weeks to allocate + config; Private VPC: ~3–4 weeks for networking; On-prem: 2–4 weeks + PS)
   - Evidence mapping: which artifacts we can provide immediately vs under NDA vs need PS involvement (e.g., log exports, KMS details, penetration test reports).
- Deliverable 2: Initial SOW template for Elara (pilot scope, acceptance criteria, SLAs, security attachments).
- Deliverable 3: List of artifacts for auditors and contact cadence (SOC2 full report request under NDA).

I’ll draft the matrix + SOW and share by EOD tomorrow. Neha — can you confirm the standard timelines for providing a full SOC2 report under NDA and whether we need an ISSA escalation to redact any sensitive IP?

Thanks — I’ll also include example pricing bands so Dylan can share with procurement.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@elarahealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T10:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment options & next steps — HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up

Following up with the details requested — high-level answers for Elara: 

1) SOC2 full report: we can provide a redacted full SOC2 Type II under NDA. Typical turnaround for our legal operations is 1–3 business days to get an NDA in place; once NDA is signed we provide the report within 24 hours.
2) BAA: our draft is attached to Dylan’s first email. We will push the BAA through counsels and expect comments in ~3 business days once you flag it to your procurement/legal.
3) KMS/HSM: Private VPC supports BYOK via AWS KMS customer keys; on-prem supports HSM appliances. We’ll include a short KMS/HSM integration appendix in the SOW.
4) Logs: we support S3 export or direct SIEM ingestion; retention 365+ is available as an add-on.
5) PS and timeline: Private VPC pilot typical timeline 3–4 weeks (network handshakes + provisioning). On-prem packaged offering requires a 2–4 week PS engagement. Dedicated provisioning is fastest (1–2 weeks) but won’t meet HSM-level key isolation.

I’m attaching the SOC2 summary again and the BAA draft for Sarah/Tom to circulate. Marissa — I’ll send the matrix + SOW draft by EOD and include the KMS appendix.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary_2026.pdf, Redwood_Draft_BAA_2027.docx
